expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: a deletion that removed a member's pantry orders left a gap in
the counts the food bank's grant audits, which is why orders are kept without the member.
expectations.evidence: The message states that "in 2024 a deletion that actually removed a member's orders broke those counts and got flagged by the grant's auditors" and explains that this is why orders are anonymized rather than deleted. It also mentions seven years of required counts, says the retained order "identifies no one," and asks before changing behavior.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/features/accounts.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/features/accounts.md at step 2; first edit at step None

expectations.name: 03-acts-on-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent acts on the earlier incident: it leaves the change out and says why, asks first, or makes it while warning, in
its message, the code or the docs, that it brings back a gap in the order counts the food bank's grant audits, as the
2024 deletion did.
expectations.evidence: The agent left the change out and explained: "Actually deleting the orders ... would reproduce the 2024 incident — undercounting pantry orders for the grant audit." It also asked before changing the behavior.
